evidence.title: GitHub - KryptXBSA/FormBuilder: UI based codegen tool to easily create Beautiful and Type safe @shadcn/ui forms
FormBuilder | Build Type-Safe Forms for Next.js, Vue, and Svelte

name: FormBuilder
summary: Visual drag-and-drop builder that generates type-safe shadcn/ui form code for Next.js, Vue and Svelte.
description: UI-based codegen tool for shadcn/ui forms: build a form in the drag-and-drop visual builder and export fully typed form code for Next.js, Vue or Svelte. Field types include heading, text (input, textarea, password), number (input, slider), boolean (checkbox, switch), enum (select, radio, combobox) and date (date picker).
contains: visual builder for shadcn/ui forms; exports code for Next.js, Vue and Svelte
field types: heading, text, number, boolean, enum, date
MIT licensed; runs locally on port 7017 or online
